title: The Role of Exosomal Biomarkers in the Monitoring of Bioactivation and Metabolite Clearance of Chemotherapeutics in Cancer Patients.
authors: Satheesh, S; Sekar, V; Kaarnika, V S; Maageswaree, B S; Bhoopendra, G K; Ibrahim, B; Nithish, S; Gowtham, V
one_liner_zh: 该文综述外泌体生物标志物在化疗药物代谢监测中的作用，虽提及lncRNA可重编程染色质结构并建议用AI整合组学，但核心对象是药物代谢与化疗耐药，非三维基因组/染色质组织建模，且无AI或分子模拟方法实质贡献。
abstract: Bioactivation and clearance of anticancer agents are crucial factors in the efficacy and toxicity of anticancer drugs. Exosomes are membrane-bound vesicles secreted by tumor cells and the tumor microenvironment. These vesicles contain drug-metabolizing enzymes, transporters, and RNA. Exosomes can be non-invasively collected from the blood. This article has been prepared by combining the evidence of the role of exosomal cytochrome P450 isoforms, such as cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 19, cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily D member 6, and cytochrome P450 family 3 subfamily A member 5, in the oxidation of anticancer drugs in the first phase of drug metabolism. Exosomal UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 has been found to help in the conjugation of anticancer drugs in the second phase of drug metabolism. Exosomal ATP-binding cassette transporters, P-glycoprotein, multidrug resistance-associated protein 1, and breast cancer resistance protein have been found to act as intercellular conveyors of drug efflux capacity. These transporters can modulate the efficacy of chemotherapy. Exosomal microRNAs, such as microRNA-21, microRNA-155, and microRNA-1246, have been found to modulate apoptosis, DNA repair, metabolic adaptation, and chemotherapy resistance through the PI3K/AKT pathway, EZH2/STAT3 pathway, and PDCD4 pathway. Long non-coding RNAs, such as UCA1 and HOXA antisense RNA, can reprogram the chromatin structure. These long non-coding RNAs can suppress tumor suppressor genes, thus leading to chemotherapy resistance. Bioinformatics pipelines have been designed to bridge the gap between exosomal RNA and protein levels in the profile of dynamic metabolic states. The challenges in the field of exosomal therapy drug monitoring have been discussed in the article. The article has recommended the use of artificial intelligence in the integration of omics with microfluidic technology for the improvement of exosomal therapy drug monitoring.
abstract_zh: 抗癌药物的生物活化和清除是影响抗癌药物疗效和毒性的关键因素。外泌体（exosomes）是由肿瘤细胞和肿瘤微环境分泌的膜结合囊泡。这些囊泡含有药物代谢酶、转运体和RNA。外泌体可从血液中非侵入性收集。本文通过综合外泌体细胞色素P450亚型（如细胞色素P450家族2亚家族C成员19、细胞色素P450家族2亚家族D成员6和细胞色素P450家族3亚家族A成员5）在药物代谢第一阶段中氧化抗癌药物作用的证据而撰写。已发现外泌体UDP-葡萄糖醛酸转移酶1A1有助于药物代谢第二阶段中抗癌药物的结合反应。已发现外泌体ATP结合盒转运体、P-糖蛋白、多药耐药相关蛋白1和乳腺癌耐药蛋白可作为药物外排能力的细胞间传递载体。这些转运体可调节化疗的疗效。已发现外泌体微小RNA（如microRNA-21、microRNA-155和microRNA-1246）通过PI3K/AKT通路、EZH2/STAT3通路和PDCD4通路调节凋亡、DNA修复、代谢适应和化疗耐药。长链非编码RNA（如UCA1和HOXA反义RNA）可重编程染色质结构。这些长链非编码RNA可抑制肿瘤抑制基因，从而导致化疗耐药。已设计生物信息学流程，以弥合动态代谢状态谱中外泌体RNA和蛋白质水平之间的差距。本文讨论了外泌体治疗药物监测领域的挑战。文章建议使用人工智能将组学与微流控技术整合，以改进外泌体治疗药物监测。
